label: Button at the heading
thesis: A solid Subscribe button sits level with the page heading, top right on the listing and in the venue header, and opens a small card with the same links and address.
risk: The panel is still one click away and the button is small beside a big heading, so it may be missed on a phone.

label: Always-open strip
thesis: A full-width strip under the heading shows every way to subscribe at once, with no click to open, on the listing and on venue pages.
risk: It takes a permanent band of height above the calendar and the area filter, pushing the shows down.

label: Side card
thesis: A card in a right-hand rail explains what subscribing does and holds the button and links, beside the listing and the venue's shows.
risk: The rail has no room on a phone, where it drops below the content, and it makes the page two-column.
